h2c_grpc_upstream.notes: Found: 'TE: trailers' was stripped before the h2c upstream (gRPC servers that require it would refuse proxied calls). Fixed in dpcore, regression test TestTETrailersIsForwardedToUpstream.

captcha_exemptions.notes: Found: a protected prefix '/private' was skipped by '/private;x=1/area' (servlet path parameter). Fixed in captcha.pathPrefixMatch, regression test TestShouldEnforcePathPathParameters.

ui_new_rule_dialog_to_traffic.notes: Found: Network Tools threw 'data.forEach is not a function' when /api/mdns/list answers the mDNS-disabled error object. One-line guard in components/networktools.html.

vdir_longest_match.notes: Observation, not a failure: vdir matching is a string prefix without a segment boundary ('/apix' goes to vdir '/api', '/api/v22' to '/api/v2'), unlike path rules which match on segment boundaries.

client_ip_trust_and_spoofing.notes: Observation: when a trusted proxy sends both X-Real-Ip and CF-Connecting-IP, X-Real-Ip wins (netutils.GetRequesterIP order). Behind Cloudflare a visitor can supply X-Real-Ip and Cloudflare does not strip it; trust only a CDN that overwrites it, or use the 'sanitise client IP headers' switch.

proxy_protocol.notes: Observation: the PROXY listener (c0va23 NewDefaultListener, no SourceChecker) honours a PROXY header from ANY peer, so anyone who can reach the listener directly can choose the client address the access lists, auto-ban and rate limit see. Only expose the port to the load balancer. See ROADMAP.

captcha_altcha_flow.notes: Session expiry itself is covered only by unit tests (session_test.go): the minimum session length is 60 s and the signing key is in memory, so an expired cookie cannot be minted from outside.

api_v1_tokens.notes: The check that a Bearer token is useless on the cookie+CSRF admin routes needs auth mode (the harness runs -noauth); it is covered by src/apiv1_test.go.

unix_socket_upstream.notes: Upstream issue #663; the task gave no fork issue number.
